package.name: bonbon_hardware_telemetry
package.description:
Unified real-hardware metrics and threshold triggers for BonBon: base-mobility wheel motors, arm joints (shoulder/elbow/wrist), head joints (pan/tilt), battery, and per-Pi (UI/AI/Navigation-Safety) system resources.
Tier 1 only (see docs/HARDWARE_TELEMETRY_METRICS_PLAN.md): every metric here comes from a real, already-wired sensor/driver reading -- wheel commanded velocity/distance (bonbon_hal motor_node), servo/ stepper position/torque/stall-lost_sync (bonbon_hal servo_node, stepper_node -- reused unchanged, not duplicated), battery voltage/ current/percent (bonbon_hal battery_node), and per-Pi CPU/RAM/disk (bonbon_safety.core.resource_monitor, sampled locally on each Pi). Fields the current hardware genuinely cannot measure (per-motor current draw, motor/servo temperature, wheel encoders, Pi CPU temp) are NOT fabricated here -- they are a documented Tier 2 follow-up that needs new sensor hardware before any software can report them.
This package does not reimplement any driver or the existing fault-classification pipeline: it aggregates real driver-level topics into per-component-group dashboard views, and publishes real bonbon_msgs/HalFault events into the ALREADY-EXISTING bonbon_fault_manager pipeline when a threshold is crossed, rather than building a second, competing alerting mechanism.
